domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n>1 (so n is positive and nonzero)
t is a real number with (n-1)/n <= t < 1
k is an integer with 1 <= k <= n
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n>1, for all real t with (n-1)/n <= t and t < 1, and for all integers k with 1 <= k <= n, the floor of k times t equals k minus 1.
quantifier_order: for all integers n such that n>1
for all real numbers t such that (n-1)/n <= t and t < 1
for all integers k such that 1 <= k and k <= n

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer universal parameter controlling the allowed range of t and the upper bound for k

variables.name: t
variables.role: inner universal real parameter constrained by (n-1)/n <= t < 1

variables.name: k
variables.role: universal integer variable whose product with t is floored; also appears in the target value k-1

witness_dependencies: none (all variables n, t, k are universally quantified; there are no existential witnesses)

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with (n-1)/n <= t < 1, one has floor(k*t) = k-1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n.
